title: 5 high paying tech jobs that don't require coding

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Five high-paying tech roles—like data architect or AI ethics officer—exist without coding, and they’re growing fast.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: High-paying? Sure, but without coding skills, you’re stuck in entry-level roles with limited career mobility.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Data scientists and AI ethicists earn six figures without coding, and demand is rising due to regulations and AI ethics protocols.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: High salaries require expertise. You can’t negotiate a six-figure deal without technical depth or specialized certifications.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: High-paying roles demand more than titles—they require mastery of tools, frameworks, and systems that coding enables.
